actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Freshdesk action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Freshdesk connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: body
input.label: Body
input.hint: Content of the note in HTML

input.name: incoming
input.label: Incoming
input.hint: Default: false. Set to true if a particular note should appear as being created from outside (i.e., not through web portal)

input.name: notify_emails
input.label: Notify emails
input.hint: Comma separated email addresses of agents who need to be notified about this note

input.name: user_id
input.label: User ID
input.hint: ID of the user who is adding the note

input.name: email
input.label: Requester's email
input.hint: Ticket requester must exist in the system

input.name: subject
input.label: Subject
input.hint: Defaults to ticket number if left empty. Required for attachment.

input.name: description
input.label: Description
input.hint: Ticket description

input.name: attachments
input.label: Attachments
input.hint: Attach files to the ticket. Total size of all attachments should not exceed 20MB.

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: Defaults to Open if left blank. Required if attachments are provided.

input.name: user_id
input.label: ID
input.hint: Get user by providing user ID

input.name: letter
input.label: Company Name
input.hint: Full or partial matches will be returned.

input.name: email

input.name: requester_id
input.label: Requester ID
input.hint: ID of the Contact

input.name: responder_id

input.hint: Use 'User ID' from Get agent details action.

input.name: tags
